referenceBasis: Installation-principle reference only, not a claim of an exact 2000 product: current YKK AP RC sash details show the sash as a distinct manufactured frame fixed to the RC opening through anchors, with perimeter field sealing; YKK AP's RC non-welded method publishes a typical frame-to-structure clearance range of 25-35 mm at three sides. This generated fallback therefore uses a conservative 30 mm rough-opening clearance per side, while retaining the scene's existing 1.46 x 1.48 m high-detail stair sash dimensions.
manufacture: Cast-in-place/reinforced-concrete stair tower is modeled as a continuous opaque shell pierced by five vertically aligned rough openings. Each opening receives a separately manufactured aluminum sash assembly; glazing, perimeter elastomer/sealant and the dark stairwell backing remain distinct optical/material layers rather than being painted into the concrete or glass.
dimensionsThickness: Tower envelope 3.20 m wide x 13.80 m high x 2.00 m deep; camera-facing RC shell depth 0.22 m; side/back/roof/base shell thickness proxy 0.18 m. Existing high-detail sash outer size 1.46 x 1.48 m; rough opening 1.52 x 1.54 m; nominal construction clearance 0.03 m each side. Visible perimeter seal 0.014 m wide x 0.012 m deep. Glass plane z=-5.370 m and interior/stairwell backing z=-5.520 m, both behind the facade plane z=-5.350 m and ahead of shell back z=-5.570 m.
materialsFinish: Painted weathered RC, aged anodized aluminum sash, dark EPDM/sealant, clear dielectric glass and non-emissive stairwell backing are separate physical classes. Concrete remains non-metallic with two-scale normal response; sash uses a high-metallic rough anodized-aluminum proxy; rubber and glass remain dielectric; no directional lighting or highlight is baked into albedo.
mounting: The legacy StairTower renderer is disabled but its gameplay collider is retained. The reconstructed RC front wall is segmented only around true voids. Existing HD_StairWindowAssembly objects are shifted 70 mm inward relative to their old generated position so their 70 mm-deep frames straddle the RC face by about 10 mm instead of floating roughly 95 mm proud. Existing facade-optics glass/backing planes are reseated behind the frame. Four-sided seal geometry owns the visible frame-to-RC interface at near LODs.
interfacesGapsSeals: Frame outer 1.46 x 1.48 m inside rough opening 1.52 x 1.54 m gives 30 mm nominal clearance on all four sides. Four-sided 14 mm visible seal strips sit immediately outside the frame perimeter, leaving the remaining installation cavity as recessed shadow/clearance rather than closing it with painted pixels. Glass is 20 mm behind the facade face and 10 mm behind the frame back; backing is 150 mm behind glass and 50 mm ahead of the 220 mm shell back. Opaque RC is forbidden from every opening clear core.
orientationExposure: Five stair windows face the camera/front side of the projecting stair tower. Front RC and sash receive coherent midsummer sun, sky fill and rain exposure; reveal depth is geometric so grazing-light shadow and occlusion follow the same sun direction as the rest of the building. The recess is shaded by construction geometry, not darkened albedo.
aging: Cause-based aging only: painted RC may chalk under UV and accumulate runoff at opening ledges; sealant may dull and darken from grime/UV; anodized aluminum may lose gloss and pick up localized oxidation/grime; glass may carry subtle non-directional surface contamination. No disaster, cracking-from-earthquake, reconstruction, impact or structural-failure narrative is permitted.
geometryVsMaterial: Geometry carries the 220 mm wall depth, five rough openings, reveal returns from the wall-piece depth, four-sided seals, frame depth and optical plane spacing. Materials carry concrete aggregate/micro-normal, paint chalking, aluminum fine roughness, seal microtexture, glass Fresnel/smoothness and subtle dirt response. Shadows, contact occlusion, reflections and highlights must be generated by Unity lighting/BRDF, never painted into albedo.
lodPolicy: LOD0/LOD1 retain the full shell silhouette plus four visible perimeter seal strips per opening. LOD2/LOD3 retain the exact same macro RC shell/opening silhouette and optical stack but omit the sub-pixel seal strips; animated cross-fade is mandatory. The rough-opening dimensions and glass depth never change between LODs, preventing silhouette/depth pop at stair windows.
